summary: CG Oncology filed an amendment to its S-3ASR prospectus to increase its at-the-market (ATM) offering capacity by $500 million, raising the aggregate offering price available under the Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC to $1.05 billion. The company previously sold 10.8 million shares for $550 million. The amendment accompanies a routine shelf takedown and ATM facility expansion, which is not a special situation. The filing includes standard risk factors and plan of distribution, with Jefferies receiving up to 3% commission. Investors should monitor the pace of ATM sales for potential dilution.
